title: GOOD: object_store startup_probe verifies PUT+DELETE permissions before accepting traffic
description: object_store_backend.rs startup_probe(): every S3/Azure/GCS backend constructor runs a PUT then DELETE of a zero-byte probe object at startup. This fails fast if IAM permissions are missing, bucket name is wrong, or network is unreachable — before any article is accepted. The error message includes the context string (bucket, prefix, region) for easy diagnosis. Decision: correct fail-fast startup verification pattern. All backends that depend on external services should implement an equivalent probe.
